note: The Academy’s response to OpenAI’s 722 manuscripts: as AI explores mathematics at scale, the scarce resource becomes human attention, judgement and understanding. Calls for new infrastructure for curating knowledge, new approaches to verification, provenance and attribution, broad access to tools, and training. With comments from James Maynard, Kevin Buzzard and Beatrice Pelloni.
title: AI opens new possibilities for mathematics — and for mathematicians
